svg.title: Manteca transit — original GTFS geometry study
svg.desc: Original illustration from City of Manteca public data; actual trip-linked shape points and stops, not current travel directions.
svg.text: Declared feed period 2026-10-01 — 2027-08-31 | 131 stops, 8 supplied shapes
Data: City of Manteca (CC BY 4.0); original coordinate projection, recoloring and annotation by Plenum.
North up; approximate local equirectangular projection. Scheduled pattern only; no live movements or ridership.
No city endorsement implied. No external map tiles, imagery or icons used.
